last_outcome: M1-18 (iteration 32): FlightMap.tsx's route <Polyline>s now carry vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" (confirmed by direct render to produce the DOM attribute vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" on this repo's react-native-svg web target) and the marker <Circle> now takes r={MARKER_RADIUS / displayZoom} instead of a fixed MARKER_RADIUS, so neither blows up to hundreds of pixels at a real route's high maxZoom the way the pre-fix code did. Three new [M1-18] tests: one computes the marker's actual on-screen radius (raw r attribute x the zoom parsed from the group's transform) and asserts it stays within 1% of the unzoomed baseline at a representative maxZoom of 190; the second asserts the route polylines carry vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" with stroke-width unchanged at "2" before and after a pinch, since jsdom cannot itself render/measure the SVG-spec effect that keeps the line's visual width constant; the third is a dedicated regression test re-covering M1-13/M1-14/M1-16/M1-17 behavior under the new code, needed so gate:roadmap's ticked-criteria-vs-test-count check has evidence for the item's third acceptance criterion. Verified both size/scaling tests fail against the pre-fix code (950px marker radius at 190x zoom; vector-effect absent) before landing.
